verdict.rationale: Data retention and deletion controls are a fair question for a cloud-synced note-taking app, but the evidence pack never documents account or space deletion, retention periods, or purge controls. The items that come closest are adjacent features, not retention or deletion controls: AI opt-in governs third-party data sharing, scheduled exports and version history concern backup and restore.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can control data retention and deletion
